title.narrative: Strengthening prevention of and response to human rights violations in developing countries in the Pacific through capacity-building

description.narrative: This project aims at the establishment of an OHCHR regional Emergency Response Team (ERT) that will enhance OHCHR’s and its partners’ capacity to take human rights action in developing countries in the Pacific region, systematically identifying, collecting, processing, analysing and sharing data, information and knowledge on human rights trends, which will capture human rights risks and opportunities for evidence-based decision-making. The project will also support capacity-building, including through the SIDS/LDC Trust Fund.
